# Captain Ahab

Ahab commands the Pequod and stands on deck looking out beyond the prow.[^moby-dick]
His hunt for the white whale is the main example of
[obsession](../concepts/obsession.md) in the novel.

[^moby-dick]: [Moby-Dick](/sources/classics/moby-dick/moby-dick.md)
